Destination Spotlight

Grab your passport, it's time to book your dream getaway!

VISIT AKUREYRI

Set at the head of a fjord, Akureyri blends small-town charm with big scenery. Think stylish restaurants, cosy bars and boutique shops, all backed by mountain views that feel straight out of a postcard. Beyond the town, North Iceland opens into a playground of natural wonders. Discover waterfalls, geothermal areas and volcanic landscapes, or head out to sea for one of Europe’s best whale-watching experiences. In summer, endless daylight invites road trips; in winter, snowy landscapes create perfect conditions for Northern Lights sightings.

You are one flight away from paradise

Discover Europe and beyond

Visit Malta

Sat in the heart of the Mediterranean, this archipelago is renowned for its exquisite coastline, golden beaches, sensational cuisine, three UNESCO World Heritage Sites and over 300 days of sunshine per year.
 
Combining awe-inspiring scenery, adrenaline-fueled activities and fascinating history, Malta has something to suit every taste.
 
Book your flight now to Malta.

FLY FROM OUR BASES

To one of our many destinations

FLY FROM LONDON

We’re making it even easier for you to get away, with an expanded network of flights from all our London airports. 

Whether you’re planning a city break, a beach holiday, or a last-minute escape, you’ll find more choice and flexibility than ever before.

With frequent flights departing daily, you can pick the time that suits you best and enjoy seamless connections to a huge range of destinations across Europe and beyond.

 

Check out our range of departures from London Luton, London Gatwick, London Stansted and Southend now.

Explore Spain

Perfect for your next sunshine escape

DISCOVER SPAIN

Ready for a change of scene? Spain’s calling—and with easyJet, getting there is a breeze. Chase the sun in Tenerife, where volcanic landscapes meet endless beaches. Dive into Barcelona’s buzzing streets for a hit of culture, or lose yourself in Palma’s mix of history and seaside vibes. After golden sands? Malaga and Alicante have you covered, with coastlines made for lazy days and spontaneous adventures.

Whether you’re squeezing in a quick weekend escape without using any annual leave or stretching out your stay for a 7 day break, we make it easy to fit travel around your life. . From city thrills to island chill, Spain’s got it all. So, what are you waiting for? Your next adventure is just a flight away.

easyJet is Europe’s leading short-haul airline and the UK's fastest growing package holiday provider. Over the last 25 years easyJet has revolutionised European air travel by allowing passengers to book cheap flights across Europe’s top flight routes, connecting more than 30 countries and over 100 cities. easyJet are committed to providing low-cost flight tickets and market-beating package holidays. At easyJet we’re not just an affordable airline but a service connecting businesses, families and holiday makers across the UK, France, Germany, Italy and other top European destinations. If you’re looking for a deal, explore our flight sales and last minute flight deals today.

Looking for a truly relaxing holiday? easyJet holidays has you covered with package holidays across Europe and North Africa. From city breaks to all inclusive escapes, and from adults only to family-friendly getaways, discover our fantastic range of holidays to suit everyone. Book your flight and accommodation together in one convenient package, and you’ll also receive a 23 kg bag included, as well as transfers for our beach and lake holidays. What’s not to love?
